title: Syria conflict tracker
description: Syria conflict: the transition, SDF integration, Suwayda, Israel, key actors, a sourced timeline, what to watch, and monthly conflict events and fatalities.
overview: This tracker reports the latest available monthly humanitarian conflict summary for Syria. It is a country-level pulse, not a comprehensive incident ledger, a full casualty count for the 2011-2024 civil war, or a forecast.
